added.en-US: Added cross-platform packages and a coordinated release pipeline for macOS and Linux testing builds.
added.zh-CN: 新增 macOS 与 Linux 内测构建的跨平台软件包及统一发布流程。

added.en-US: Added operating-system and architecture-aware plugin package selection.
added.zh-CN: 插件包现可根据操作系统与处理器架构自动选择。

changed.en-US: Plugin downloads now use a complete prebuilt index to reduce GitHub requests.
changed.zh-CN: 插件下载改用完整预索引，减少对 GitHub 的请求。

changed.en-US: Platform data directories, runtime paths, and update handling were unified.
changed.zh-CN: 统一各平台的数据目录、运行路径与更新处理逻辑。

fixed.en-US: Fixed startup and runtime issues affecting macOS and Linux builds.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 macOS 与 Linux 构建的启动和运行问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed missing AppImage icons and improved cross-platform build reliability.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 AppImage 图标缺失，并提升跨平台构建可靠性。

fixed.en-US: Fixed tooltip visibility, Cleanroom content selection, and platform path handling.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复提示框显示、Cleanroom 内容选择及跨平台路径处理问题。

changed.en-US: The plugin marketplace now prioritizes the official prebuilt index and no longer keeps a repository disk cache.
changed.zh-CN: 插件市场现优先使用官方预索引，并移除仓库磁盘缓存。

fixed.en-US: Unavailable Java installations are removed from the list after a refresh.
fixed.zh-CN: 刷新 Java 列表后会自动移除已经失效的安装项。

changed.en-US: Plugin marketplace loading was rebuilt around the official index.
changed.zh-CN: 插件市场加载流程围绕官方索引进行了重构。

fixed.en-US: Launcher restart now waits for the previous process lock to be released.
fixed.zh-CN: 启动器重启时会等待旧进程释放文件锁。

fixed.en-US: Fixed stale Java installations remaining visible after refresh.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复刷新后仍显示失效 Java 安装项的问题。

added.en-US: Added automatic Jar-in-Jar mod parsing and more complete crash-report exports.
added.zh-CN: 新增内嵌模组（Jar-in-Jar）自动解析与更完整的崩溃报告导出。

added.en-US: Instance exports can now include folders not covered by existing rules.
added.zh-CN: 实例导出现在可以包含未被既有规则覆盖的文件夹。

changed.en-US: The launcher runtime and dependencies were updated to .NET 10.
changed.zh-CN: 启动器运行时与依赖已升级至 .NET 10。

changed.en-US: Memory and download-speed units now use IEC notation.
changed.zh-CN: 内存与下载速度单位改用 IEC 标准。

removed.zh-CN: 移除 Quilt 加载器支持。

fixed.en-US: Fixed multiple download, login, cache, tooltip, and crash-report reliability issues synchronized from upstream.
fixed.zh-CN: 同步修复多项下载、登录、缓存、提示框及崩溃报告可靠性问题。
